title: Practice: grade a tool set on schema rules (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a well made tool lints clean and a poor one is named for every rule it breaks
cases.says: A well made tool is clean and a poor one is named for every rule it breaks

cases.id: e1 names must match the pattern and a vague name is flagged
cases.says: Names must match the pattern, and a vague name is flagged in any case

cases.id: e2 a description needs three sentences a when to use phrase and a boundary against the neighbour
cases.says: A description needs three sentences, a when-to-use phrase and a boundary

cases.id: e3 parameters are described and required names exist and closed sets are enums and examples fit the schema
cases.says: Parameters are described, required names exist, closed sets are enums, examples fit the schema

cases.id: e4 a list tool needs a limit and a cursor and a hint may not contradict the name
cases.says: A list tool needs a limit and a cursor, and a hint may not contradict the name

cases.id: e5 a set is graded for duplicate names overlapping descriptions and size
cases.says: A set is graded for duplicate names, overlapping descriptions at the threshold, and size at the budget

cases.id: e6 pages carry an opaque cursor and a clamped limit and a note
cases.says: Pages carry an opaque cursor, a clamped limit and a note, and refuse a bad limit or cursor

cases.id: e7 a page stops at the size cap and says so but always carries one item
cases.says: A page stops at the size cap, says so, and always carries one item

cases.id: e8 a tools own hints are trusted only from a trusted server and the defaults apply otherwise
cases.says: A tool's own hints count only from a trusted server
